segments.text: A ticket arrives. You need more than a label. You need the right action, and a recorded result.
Charged twice. System One selects payments. Pi runs the assignment tool and records the outcome.
Now change the ticket. Payment failed, and the service is down. This needs more evidence.
When enabled, System One asks System Two to investigate, using only the tools you permit.
The helper checks the order and service status, then returns evidence of an outage.
System One uses that evidence to choose S O S. Pi assigns the ticket and records the result.
Turbo connects the flow. You supply the policy and relevant state. Keep your Pi extensions and M C P tools. Fast judgments drive. Deeper reasoning helps when needed.
